crossRefs.note: but Peter was standing at the door outside. So the other disciple, who was known to the high priest, went out and spoke…
Now Peter was sitting outside in the court, and a maid came to him, saying, “You were also with Jesus, the Galilean!”
But he denied it before them all, saying, “I don’t know what you are talking about.”
As Peter was in the courtyard below, one of the maids of the high priest came,
They seized him, and led him away, and brought him into the high priest’s house. But Peter followed from a distance.
A certain servant girl saw him as he sat in the light, and looking intently at him, said, “This man also was with him.”
He denied Jesus, saying, “Woman, I don’t know him.”
They answered him, “Jesus of Nazareth.” Jesus said to them, “I am he.” Judas also, who betrayed him, was standing with…
Jesus answered, “I told you that I am he. If therefore you seek me, let these go their way,”
So when they had eaten their breakfast, Jesus said to Simon Peter, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me more than…
But Peter answered him, “Even if all will be made to stumble because of you, I will never be made to stumble.”

people.name: Peter
people.line: Apostle of Jesus, leader in the early church

translations.web: Then the maid who kept the door said to Peter, “Are you also one of this man’s disciples?” He said, “I am not.”
translations.bsb: At this, the servant girl watching the door said to Peter, “Aren’t you also one of this man’s disciples?” “I am not,” he answered.
translations.kjv: Then saith the damsel that kept the door unto Peter, Art not thou also one of this man's disciples? He saith, I am not.
translations.asv: The maid therefore that kept the door saith unto Peter, Art thou also one of this man's disciples? He saith, I am not.
